dedupe_keys.name: china gridded co2 storage and injection capacity

description: The China CO2 storage research team publishes gridded geological storage potential and injection-rate capacity for China. Five GeoTIFF layers distinguish saline-aquifer and oilfield storage, with average and maximum injection estimates where provided. Coverage uses five-kilometre cells in a WGS 1984 Lambert conformal conic projection, alongside county and province summaries in an Excel workbook. Storage units are megatonnes and injection units are megatonnes per year. The public Figshare release is free under CC BY 4.0. These estimates can constrain carbon-storage and transport simulations, with model-pypsa-eur illustrating a related sector-coupled modelling context that would require adaptation to China. A caveat is that regional potential is not a permitted or engineering-qualified injection site. Geological uncertainty, pressure interactions and infrastructure costs require separate assessment. No raster values were downloaded.
